detail.longDescription:
Bram Cohen typed "(the above file is legal, by the way)" under his first BitTorrent demo in 2001. It was a jazz song sent through his file-sharing program.

Linux projects publish their own downloads as torrents. I have shipped Linux since the early 2000s. I still feel guilty downloading it by torrent, as if someone who doesn't know what is legal will charge me.

I got that guilt from Hollywood's lawsuits against torrent sites, and Cohen's note belongs on every Linux torrent.

#OpenSource #Linux
